en.topic_title: Death toll in Chongqing landslide rises to 41, authorities say
en.topic_summary:
Rescuers found another 30 people killed in a landslide that struck southwestern China this month, authorities said, bringing the death toll to 41.



Rescue workers search for survivors at the site of a landslide in Pengshui County in Chongqing, China on July 17, 2026. Photo: CNS/AFP/China OUT.



The landslide, which occurred on July 17 in Chongqing’s Pengshui County, swept away several residential buildings at the foot of a mountain and along a riverbank.
